name: SELENE two-pose fixed-light comparison

original_specification.name: SELENE two-pose fixed-light comparison
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for before-and-after arm or vial positions.
original_specification.sources: One fixed external studio rig or one environment sun
original_specification.geometry: Choice of studio versus physical lunar mode is explicit and not mixed
original_specification.contribution_policy: Shared sources and camera; same contribution policy for both poses
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.
validation: Comparison labels mode and never rescales lights per pose

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
